title: Agent Workbench

middlewareOrder.title: Execution extensions
middlewareOrder.hint: Extensions in the same stage follow this list, then the default order. Save to apply changes to new sessions only.
middlewareOrder.empty: Select published execution extensions in Capabilities to configure their order here.
middlewareOrder.missing: Extension is unavailable or no longer selected. Restore it or reset the order.
middlewareOrder.toolAccess: Tool checks can read the tool name and shared parameters. They can block execution, but cannot grant permissions, replace your approval or change parameters. A failed check stops execution.
middlewareOrder.createHint: Edit and publish a draft, then return to Capabilities to select it. Creating a draft does not enable it.
middlewareOrder.createFailed: The check draft could not be created. Try again explicitly; no extension was selected.

contextOrder.title: Context order
contextOrder.hint: Context is added in this order within each stage, then in the default order. Save to apply changes to new sessions only.
contextOrder.empty: Add context extensions in Capabilities to configure their order.
contextOrder.missing: Unavailable or no longer selected. Restore the contribution or reset the order.

subtitle: Configure your Agents around the work you want to do.

providers.defaultsHint: Configured by the installation owner. New or re-saved Agents inherit these defaults unless overridden. Saved versions and existing sessions remain unchanged. Save each choice separately.
providers.defaultsMissingHint: The previous default or its contract is unavailable. Its selection is retained. Restore the plugin or explicitly choose another implementation.
providers.defaultsLoadError: Cannot read defaults. Check that you are the installation owner, then reload.
providers.defaultsSaveError: Save failed: the implementation may be unavailable or another operation changed the default. Reload and confirm your choice.
providers.title: Component implementations
providers.hint: Choose implementations for the selected capabilities. Saving checks compatibility and dependencies; execution still requires authorization. Existing sessions keep their frozen implementation. Choosing a component does not add its internal tools to the Agent.
providers.empty: Selected capabilities do not expose replaceable components. Add a capability with a component contract first.
providers.missingHint: The selected implementation or its contract is no longer in the catalog. Your choice has been kept. Choose another implementation or explicitly use the configured default.

freshStart.title: Fresh v4 workspace
freshStart.body: This generation starts with {{count}} official templates and an empty personal library. Previous settings are not imported; fork a template or create a new Agent here.

productBinding.chooseModelLater: Choose an Agent first, then configure a compatible chat model.
productBinding.loadFailed: Could not load Agent options. Please retry.
productBinding.saveFailed: Could not update the Agent. Please try again later.
productBinding.modelChanged: The current model is incompatible with this Agent. Options have been refreshed; please select again.
productBinding.busy: Wait for the current reply to finish before switching Agents.
productBinding.currentUnavailable: Current Agent unavailable: {{reason}}. Choose another model or Agent.

reasons.vision: The current model does not support image understanding

productBinding.label: Agent setup
productBinding.companionHint: Changes apply to this companion's desktop, robot and IM conversations. The official Companion is used by default.

library.title: Agent library
library.subtitle: Official templates and your Agent setups
library.deleteConfirmBody: It can no longer be edited or used for new conversations. Existing conversation history is preserved.

template.capabilityHint: Add or remove capabilities for your work. Saving creates your own Agent and keeps the official preset available.
template.hostUnavailable: This template includes capabilities that are unavailable on the current Nomi-core host. Forking stays blocked until a real owner is available.
template.zeroToolBody: No capability, Skill, MCP, workspace, Coding context, or hidden capability search is constructed.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.description: Keeps only base chat and current-message input; no capability module, Skill, MCP tool, or resource is bound.

general.name: General
general.description: A ready-to-customize set of research, knowledge, workspace, collaboration, and extension modules.

codex.name: Coding
codex.description: Combines workspace I/O, version control, processes, deliverables, project memory, research, and collaboration. Computer control can be added when needed.

default.name: Companion
default.description: Combines companion identity, long-term memory, knowledge, and schedules. Channels, robots, and computer control can be connected when needed.

default.name: Customer Service
default.description: Combine knowledge, communication and customer records for service work.

default.name: Multimodal
default.description: For professional multimodal work across media, canvas, Office, workspace, project memory, and web research.

agentCollaboration.name: Agent collaboration
agentCollaboration.description: Delegate bounded work, fork an authorized Agent task, or request a user decision.

automationSchedule.name: Schedules
automationSchedule.description: Create and manage durable schedules without exposing scheduler internals.

browser.name: Browser
browser.description: Observe and interact with a bound managed browser or authorized Chrome. The provider never adds permissions.

channelMessaging.name: Channel messaging
channelMessaging.description: Reply or send through a channel selected by the usage target.

companion.name: Companion
companion.description: Learn and evolve the selected companion within its product boundary.

companionMemory.name: Companion memory
companionMemory.description: Recall or write memory for the selected companion.

computer.name: Computer
computer.description: High-privilege extension. Missing OS grants disable only Computer actions, not the Agent's other capabilities.

creationMedia.name: Media creation
creationMedia.description: Create text, images, video, audio and music through configured generation services.

creativeWorkshop.name: Creative workshop
creativeWorkshop.description: Work with canvases, assets and reusable creative templates.

customerService.name: Customer service
customerService.description: Read and update service notes or hand work to a person.

knowledge.name: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Search, read and update a knowledge base selected when the Agent is used.

office.name: Office
office.description: Preview and edit documents, spreadsheets and presentations.

pluginDevelopment.name: Plugin development
pluginDevelopment.description: Read, edit, publish and serve a selected Plugin project.

projectMemory.name: Project memory
projectMemory.description: Read or write durable memory for the selected project.

requirements.name: Requirements
requirements.description: Read, write, update and claim work from the requirements platform.

robot.name: Robot
robot.description: Observe and control an explicitly bound robot device.

ssh.name: SSH
ssh.description: Read files or run authorized commands on a selected SSH host.

toolDiscovery.name: Tool selection policy
toolDiscovery.description: When many tools are available, filter and rank only the authorized tools relevant to the current request. This grants no new authority.

webResearch.name: Web research
webResearch.description: Search public sources and fetch pages without using browser sign-in state.

workspaceArtifacts.name: Deliverables
workspaceArtifacts.description: Publish workspace files as verified deliverables or read published content by artifact ID.

workspaceFiles.name: Workspace I/O
workspaceFiles.description: Read, search, create, and modify files by path inside the workspace.

workspaceProcess.name: Local processes
workspaceProcess.description: Start, observe, and control local command processes in the workspace.

workspaceVcs.name: Version control
workspaceVcs.description: Inspect and explicitly change version-control state in the selected workspace.

availability.offline: The selected device is offline. Reconnect it and refresh the catalog.
availability.permission_denied: Permission is denied. Open the relevant system settings, grant access, then refresh.
availability.missing_hardware: No compatible device is connected. Connect the hardware, then refresh.
availability.no_desktop: Desktop control is unavailable in this environment.
availability.unsupported_platform: This module is not supported on the current platform.
availability.unknown: Availability could not be confirmed. Refresh the catalog before enabling this module.

sections.basicHint: Define its identity, model and working style
sections.capabilitiesHint: Choose product modules, then refine their permitted actions
sections.skillsMcpHint: Skills contribute instructions only. MCP tools enter this Agent through their available capability.

fields.name: Name
fields.chatModelRouteUnavailable: Configure an available chat model before saving this Agent.

status.noRevision: This draft has no saved Revision yet.
status.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Saving applies them to new conversations.
status.revisionImmutable: Saved revisions are immutable; edits create the next Revision.

capabilities.catalogUnavailable: No usable implementation of this capability is available on this installation.
capabilities.unavailableReason: This installation does not currently provide an executable owner for this capability, so it cannot be selected.

resources.bindingStatusHint: These are resource kinds the capabilities may use. Concrete targets are bound by the session or product scene when needed.
resources.pickerHint: Choose only targets needed for this session. Unbound enhancements do not block the session; their tools stay unavailable.
resources.companionBindingHint: Use this companion's shared conversation and settings. Channel and robot are optional; chat and companion memory remain available without them.
resources.runtimeUnavailableCount: {{count}} capability environments unavailable; the session can still start
resources.dependencyHint: Matching resources appear after you select {{resource}}.
resources.selectionHint: This resource is used for this launch and can be changed before the next one.
resources.mcpSelectionHint: Include every server used by the Agent's authorized tools. With MCP resources selected, you may add resource servers (16 total). Selection grants no extra tools; resource reads must target a bound server.
resources.emptyOptions: No available resource. Configure one before starting.
resources.emptyOptional: No resource is available. You can still use the Agent's other capabilities.
resources.loadFailed: The resource list could not be loaded. Check its configuration page.

robotPhases.offline: Offline — Robot actions are unavailable; the Agent's other capabilities still work

resources.robotPermissionsNotRequired: No Robot action permission is required by this Agent
resources.computerCheckFailed: Computer availability could not be verified. The Agent remains usable; check system settings before invoking these actions.
resources.computerReady: The required Computer actions are available on this desktop.
resources.computerPermissionNeeded: Computer actions are unavailable for now. The Agent remains usable and these actions recover after you grant access.
resources.computerPermissionScope: This Agent needs: {{permissions}}. OS access does not expand the Agent's capability boundary.
resources.computerPermissionNotRequired: This Agent only launches apps or URLs and needs neither Screen Recording nor Accessibility.
resources.bindingPolicyTitle: Manage capability grants and resource bindings separately
resources.bindingPolicyBody: The Agent configuration grants capabilities; the session or product scene binds knowledge, workspaces, devices, and connections. An unbound resource or unready environment disables only the affected tools and does not block the Agent's other capabilities.

errors.title: Agent Workbench could not complete the operation
errors.presetCapabilitiesLoadFailed: The selected Agent's capabilities could not be loaded. Retry or choose another Agent.
errors.routeUnavailable: This app build does not expose the current Agent workflow. Update or restart the matching service, then retry.
errors.network: The local service could not be reached. Check that NomiFun is running, then retry.
errors.timeout: The operation did not finish before the deadline. Retry once; if the outcome is uncertain, inspect the existing Session first.
errors.presetNotFound: This Agent no longer exists. Reload Agent Workbench.
errors.sessionDeleted: This Session was deleted and cannot be continued.
errors.sessionNotFound: This Session is no longer available. Choose another Agent setup.
errors.snapshotUnavailable: This saved setup cannot run on the current Nomi Runtime. Create a new Session from an available setup.
errors.resource: Choose or configure every resource required by this Agent before continuing.
errors.capability: One or more selected Modules or Actions are unavailable. Review the highlighted setup items and save again.
errors.model: Choose an available Chat model before saving this setup.
errors.conflict: This setup changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving again.
errors.runtime: Nomi Runtime could not start this operation. Check the selected model and Modules, then retry.
errors.unknown: The Agent operation could not be completed. Review the selected model and Modules, then retry.

workbench.missingReason: The source of this module is missing. Remove it, or restore the corresponding extension before using it.
workbench.noResultsHint: Try another keyword, category or status filter.
workbench.officialHint: Start with a preset and make it yours
workbench.myHint: Prepare the right Agent for your work
workbench.customizeHint: Adjust capabilities and save your own Agent. The official preset stays available.
workbench.saveHint: This saved revision is ready for new conversations.
workbench.previewCompileHint: Save runs the authoritative server compile for the exact actions, providers and resource requirements.
workbench.selectedHint: Choose capability modules for the scenario, then review their exact actions
workbench.settingsHint: Define its identity, model and working style
workbench.modelNeeded: Configure an available chat model before saving this Agent.
workbench.runtimePolicyNeeded: Select a bypass model before saving rules plus bypass model.
workbench.configureModelReturn: After configuring a model, use Back to continue editing. Your unsaved Agent inputs are kept for this return.
workbench.returnChanged: This Agent changed while you were away. Its current saved version is open; the earlier unsaved inputs were not applied.
workbench.disabledSave: Resolve unavailable modules or actions before saving
workbench.changeBlockedBody: Unavailable dependencies, revision conflicts or mutually exclusive modules: {{names}}. Resolve these first.
workbench.enableDependencies: These dependencies will also be enabled: {{names}}.
workbench.disableDependents: These enabled modules depend on the removed items and will also be disabled: {{names}}.
workbench.moduleGuide: The list includes directly configurable modules and read-only dependencies brought in by this configuration. Skill and MCP binding details remain under Skills & extensions.
workbench.dependencyHint: Required by {{names}}. It is frozen with them when saved and cannot be toggled independently here.
workbench.moduleUnavailableSummary: {{count}} enabled modules, actions, or runtime conditions need attention.
workbench.moduleUnavailable: This Module is unavailable on the current installation. Open technical details for diagnostics.
workbench.systemPermissionMissing: Missing system access: {{permissions}}. You can save the Module, but must grant access before using it.
workbench.systemPermissionCheckFailed: NomiFun could not verify this Module's system permissions. Check the permission center.
workbench.actionMissing: A previously saved action is no longer published. Remove it or restore its source.
workbench.actionRequired: Choose at least one action before saving this Module.
workbench.contextOnlyModule: This module contributes context or events and has no selectable actions.
workbench.noModulesHint: Refresh the installation catalog or enable a product extension that publishes Agent modules.
workbench.firstRunHint: Minimal provides base chat only, with no Skill, MCP tool, or capability module. You can also start blank and add capabilities one by one.
workbench.emptyWorkbenchHint: No official presets or personal Agents are available. Start with a blank custom Agent and add modules from the installed catalog.

runtimePolicy.title: Runtime & supervision
runtimePolicy.hint: Choose the recovery policy used when this Agent creates a new Session. The policy is frozen with the Revision and never rewrites existing Sessions.

agent.title: Agent default
agent.description: Saved with the current immutable Revision

session.title: Frozen for a new Session
session.description: Copied at creation; later defaults are not read

override.title: Session override
override.description: The capsule changes only that Session, never the Agent

runtimePolicy.applyNote: Saving the Agent affects only Sessions created afterward. Existing Sessions keep their already-frozen settings.
runtimePolicy.busy: This Agent is being saved. Try again in a moment.
